incidents.name: Perpetual Protocol OrderBook funding-growth poisoning
incidents.notes: OrderBook.updateFundingGrowthAndLiquidityCoefficientInFundingPayment omitted its clearing-house-only guard, so a direct call poisoned cached funding growth and converted fabricated PnL into withdrawals from two deployments.

sources.ref: trace shows the same unguarded OrderBook selector hit 0x772f48f073c1f328c264619fc3bba28e3efdefb0 and 0x4e26b6815d82baa6b8c15fe4ffb646dfb4b474c7; the latter caused 2,990.435495 of the total 3,062.213107 USDC.e loss and was deployed by 0x849a19c0746fb0d335e02dec0d0b3e057e585176
